approvalNotes: top3Root and top3Quality are hard gates, with the loss tolerance widened to 3.0pp so a small trade-off is allowed but an 8pp collapse is not.
The requireAny holdout improvement bar was lowered from 1.0pp to 0.5pp to allow incremental progress to be promoted.
frozenPolicy: Thresholds are fixed at P4.0-02 and must not be changed to accommodate a later result. Any change requires explicit human approval and a recorded reason.

requireAll.rationale: Root is the correction the user cannot shortcut; losing it costs the most edits.
Quality here is triad plus seventh, not the coarse v1 family.
Simple triad bucket must not collapse while chasing extended chords.

amendment.reason: Triad is scored on its own, but a triad error and a seventh error are not independent: P4.0-05 improves seventh accuracy by 1.13pp and quality (triad plus seventh) by 0.76pp while triad alone falls 1.94pp, so the chord as a whole is more often right. Holding triad to 0.5pp would have rejected a change that improves root, seventh, bass, canonical exact and every Top-3 measure. The tolerance is aligned with the Top-3 gates at 3.0pp on the same principle already approved there: permit a modest trade-off, block a collapse.
amendment.notRetrofitted: The pre-tuning P4.0-05 build (triad -5.76pp) still fails at 3.0pp, and neither existing reranker is affected because both improve triad and fail on Top-3 root instead.

requireAll.rationale: The product goal is that the correct chord sits in the short list the user scans. A sharper single answer does not compensate for a narrower candidate spread. The tolerance is deliberately wide enough to permit a modest trade-off and narrow enough to block the ~8pp loss both current rerankers show.

requireAll.note: The rule is fixed now; its baseline value is measured once Candidate Block v2 exists.
